capabilities: View and edit CSV files as sortable tables with search and filtering
Edit JSON files with live validation, pretty formatting, and minifying
Inspect log files with level filters, search, and auto-scroll
Read VTT and SRT transcripts as searchable timestamped cue lists
Enable or disable each file type viewer in plugin options
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README states it works entirely offline with no network requests, telemetry, or accounts.
problem: Obsidian opens data and text-based files like CSV, JSON, logs, and transcripts as raw plain text with no tables, filters, or structured views.
summary: Opens CSV, JSON, log, and VTT/SRT files in purpose-built views with sortable tables, inline editing, validation, filters, and search.
